The issuer shows modest profitability (net margin ~3.9%, EBIT margin ~5.4%) but relatively weak balance-sheet strength, with high leverage (total liabilities of 13,829M vs. shareholders’ equity of 3,165M; equity ratio ~19%) and negative working capital (current liabilities exceed current assets). Liquidity and leverage risk are therefore material, limiting credit quality despite positive earnings.

DECISION: BBB-
